// ACCEPTED. Identical logic as guard clauses: each precondition is stated and
// dismissed on one line, and the real work sits at depth 0.
export function flat(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean, d: boolean): number {
  if (!a) return 0;
  if (!b) return 0;
  if (!c) return 0;
  return d ? 1 : 0;
}
